name: Dumbbell Decline Shrug
steps: Set the bench on a gentle slope and brace your feet at its lower end.
Rest your chest on the pad facing the raised end, with a dumbbell hanging from each hand.
Keep your arms straight as you draw your shoulder blades up and back toward your spine.
Pause briefly squeezing your traps, then lower your shoulders slowly until your arms hang freely.
tips: Keep your chest supported and your elbows straight so you do not turn the lift into a row.
Keep your neck neutral rather than craning your head upward.
